scope: Native MCP roots/list fulfillment and bounded input_required continuation over stdio and HTTP

behavior.root_scope: The already admitted active workspace only
behavior.continuation: Echoes opaque requestState and retries with a fresh request ID, bounded to ten rounds
behavior.unsupported_requests: Remain unresolved; no success is reported and the tool is not replayed

product_position: OpenCode and LiteLLM are design and coverage references only; API compatibility and feature parity are not requirements.
